threads.label: Talk Tennis
threads.title: Brian Gottfried: will his incredible record of 8 runner-up finishes still stand in 2026?
threads.body: In the legendary year of 1977—when Vilas was setting record after record and deserved the world number one spot that ultimately went to Connors—another tennis player achieved some extraordinary results: Brian Gottfried, who reached 15 finals. Brian won 5 titles and lost 10 finals, setting an incredible record that I believe has only been matched by Auger-Aliassime: losing 8 consecutive finals. Let me try to summarize it all.

threads.title: Two-Handed Backhand
threads.body: I wish somebody told me this (maybe they did and I wasn’t paying attention), but when you close the racquet face, it forces a racquet drop and gives you topspin. I had a tendency to go back with a vertical racquet face, and my swing was very flat. The ball felt like it was sailing of if I brushed up.
